prompt_fragment: This asset is a background or texture. Prioritize atmosphere and surface coherence over a single isolated subject.
raw_description:
Seamless aged parchment texture — warm cream base with subtle variations,
faint foxing spots, occasional fiber, hint of horizontal grain. A
background surface — no patterns, no illustration.
formatted_prompt: Editorial field-journal illustration in ink and watercolor on aged parchment, seamless surface texture filling the full frame with no central subject. Warm cream vellum ground — ivory shifting to pale ochre and bone — with subtle tonal variation across the sheet, uneven fiber density visible as soft horizontal striations beneath the surface. Faint foxing spots scattered irregularly, rust-brown and amber, small and diffuse. Occasional exposed paper fiber catches the light as a fine thread. Muted, contemplative, archival register; no figures, no linework, no patterns, no illustration. Restrained color saturation throughout — warm vellum (#E7E3D5), slate-shadow undertones at edges, ember-ochre foxing as rare warm accent. Even ambient light, no cast shadows, pure surface.
